scope: Offscreen Qt6.12 software-rendered UI regression tests with generated endpoint state. No physical touch, audio, laptop latency or overall mixing acceptance.

original_ui_regressions.interpretation: Four cancelled seek rows submitted unwanted commands; two held channel gain rows jumped on ACK; two ownership-label layout rows lacked the new label.
original_ui_regressions.fixture_note: Regression-first native-Slider fixtures before the final MouseArea ownership change. Current grab-loss fixtures target the actual MouseArea mouse grab.

coverage: No C++/Python product sources changed. QML remains numerically unmeasured; these functional tests do not establish a QML coverage percentage.
limitations: Qt6.4 uses MouseArea grab loss with synthesized single-touch mouse input; Qt6.12 additionally uses actual QTest platform cancellation. Supported-version CI is tracked separately.
The full passing suite retains existing warnings from older CUE/layout fixtures.
Hardware touch and the user overall two-track mixing verdict remain pending.

supported_version_followup.observed_failure: Qt6.4 first lacked the EventPoint QML enum; after correcting that alias, valid releases still failed with the passive/native pointer split.
supported_version_followup.final_implementation: The existing MouseArea pattern owns pointer press, release and cancellation; the native Slider retains focus, keyboard and accessible range.
supported_version_followup.final_CI: See the final checks on https://github.com/kyaulabs/conflux/pull/62. These local results establish Qt6.12 only.
